remarks: Welcome to Oyster Bend-a fitting name for this remarkable waterside retreat offering panoramic views of Long Island and just steps to the water and kayak park. Thoughtfully landscaped gardens frame the property, while a crushed oyster shell path leads to the entry and an eye-catching oyster shell-covered fireplace connecting the living and dining rooms. This space transitions effortlessly from breezy summer to cozy winter. The coastal-style kitchen features a beachy vibe, premium appliances and a convenient pantry. The kitchen flows into a family room, screened-in porch, and patio (new '23) all with stunning water views. The main level includes a welcoming foyer, mudroom, powder room, and alcove for a home office or reading nook. Upstairs,the primary suite offers cathedral ceilings, dual walk-in closets, new bath in '24 and serene views. A 2nd BR includes an office alcove, double closets, and a lockable 'renters closet', additional attic space. 3rd BR accesses a large attic. 4th BR, a private guest suite with sitting room, en-suite bath, and separate staircase, is perfect for many uses. The dry basement offers ample storage. An oversized L-shaped garage with glass doors includes a well-equipped gym with water views. Energy-efficiency upgrades with many smart home features and spray foam insulation, solar panels, new on-demand hot water '25. FH generator. Located in Shorefront Park, a unique private community with 2 waterfront parks for kayaking, swimming and social events.
